record.title: Identify the delivered RF source and qualify its proposed role
record.intent: Replace advertised assumptions with observed equipment facts before connecting the signal path.
requirements: Require confirmed arrival and applicable operator authorization for the source checks. Start isolated from the scope; a task being ready does not itself authorize hardware interaction.
Retain private model/revision and supplied-manual evidence, connector and power identification, output controls and startup behavior. Compare the delivered unit with the phase-A assumptions.

Perform only the accepted source checks and record available level, frequency, stability and spectral evidence without claiming unmeasured properties. No source modification, firmware replacement or unplanned connection.

Seal accession evidence and record suitability or the exact shortfall. Unexpected equipment changes require protocol/contract reconciliation before integration; preserve a negative qualification result.
acceptance: The delivered source is identified and its supported role or specific qualification shortfall is evidenced separately from seller claims.
